verdict.rationale: Supabase's own Storage docs cover the whole story. Uploads are documented via S3-compatible, REST and TUS resumable protocols, with fine-grained access control through row-level security and custom policies. Delivery is via a global CDN in over 285 cities, and on-the-fly image transformations are available, though only on Pro and above. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of storage access rules and CDN delivery, and deeper documentation of the access-policy mechanics beyond summary claims.
